sn47.8:1.1: _Nānāccaya_ appears only here. I take it as _nānā_ + _accaya_, “excessive variety”, which suits the context. The commentary takes it as a variant of _nānācaya_, “consisting of various mixtures”.
sn47.8:1.2: Elsewhere _madhuragga_ means a “sweet tip” ([sn1.71:3.4]()) or the “superbly sweet” mango ([ja511:6.4]()). | Sour, sweet, and bitter flavors are remembered at [thag16.2:8.1]().
